draft:
Dear Ramesh Kumar,

I am writing to dispute the deductions of INR 1,000.00 made from my security deposit for Flat 304, Green Glen Layout. 

Specifically, the lease does not require the tenant to pay for carpet cleaning (INR 250), wall repainting (INR 600), or trash removal (INR 150) upon move-out. Under Clause 2, painting is the landlord's responsibility. The flat was returned in clean condition subject to normal wear and tear.

Please refund the full amount of INR 1,000.00 within 14 days.

Sincerely,
Kirti Singh
